text: Illustrate the story here: King and Ash Sing King and Ash are best pals. To have fun, King and Ash sing songs. King brings Ash a book of songs. "Which song should we sing?" asks King. "Let's pick a quick song and then a long song," said Ash. King and Ash sing their songs. King's mom just got back from the shop. "Will you sing me a song?" she asks. "Yes!" yell Ash and King. They grab the book of songs. "We have to pick the best song for your mom," said Ash. King looks in the book. He sees the best song. "This is it," he says. King and Ash sing. King's mom claps and says, "I am so glad you sang that song."
